expected: Constitution invariant 3: a spec that validates generates; a validator accepts only methods and parameters the target engine runs. The Spark validator refuses at construction, with a SpecValidationError naming the column, every pool Spark cannot merge into one column type.
repro: python -c "from pyspark.sql import SparkSession, functions as F; from rand_engine.main.spark_generator import SparkGenerator; s=SparkSession.builder.master('local[1]').getOrCreate(); SparkGenerator(s, F, {'c': {'method': 'distincts', 'kwargs': {'distincts': [1, True]}}}).size(5).get_df().collect()"
symptom: SparkGenerator(spark, F, {'c': {'method': 'distincts', 'kwargs': {'distincts': [1, True]}}}) constructs without error; .size(5).get_df() raises PySparkTypeError [CANNOT_MERGE_TYPE] Can not merge type LongType and BooleanType. Same for [1.5, False] (DoubleType/BooleanType) and [date(2020,1,1), 1] (DateType/LongType). [True, 'x'], ['x', None], [1, 2.5], [True, None] and [date, 'x'] generate.
title: SparkGenerator validates distincts pools whose types Spark cannot merge, then fails at get_df
